content: Snooze/defer UX for SaaS alerts: Linear is the canonical reference — each notification card has 'Done / Snooze / Open' inline. Key patterns: (1) snooze durations as named options ('Amanhã', 'Próxima semana', 'Em 30 dias') not raw date pickers — simpler for non-technical users; (2) snooze state must persist server-side per insight/org (not browser state); (3) snoozed insights disappear from the active panel and resurface when the snooze expires; (4) 'View snoozed' link lets users see and cancel snoozes; (5) snooze differs from 'dismiss' — dismissed = resolved/irrelevant, snoozed = relevant but not now. For analytics advisor insights: snooze makes sense for time-sensitive insights (e.g., 'TACoS alto' — may self-correct); dismiss makes sense for informational ones already acted upon.
